description: Just last week, I was in Highmore celebrating Old Settler Days. I had planned to use this week’s News from the Road to reflect on the thoughtful conversations I had there about the future of public education.Then everything changed.On Monday, June 29, straight-line winds devastated the Highmore community. Gusts reaching 131 mph ripped roofs from homes, flattened farm buildings, and crushed grain bins like tin cans. According to various local news sources, these may have been the second strongest
title: When Disaster Strikes, South Dakotans Come Together
